extracted.intended_audience: research community, grant applicants/administrators, policy analysts, and members of the public interested in NIH funding trends
extracted.subtask_description: Using the NIH 'Awards by Month' resource to view and analyze monthly counts and total funding of NIH extramural awards across fiscal years, including interactive exploration and data export for further analysis or presentation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Interactive monthly awards charts
rubrics_metrics.description: Provides interactive charts showing the number and total funding of NIH extramural awards by month over recent fiscal years.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Figures allow comparison of seasonal patterns and year-to-year trends in award activity; charts are interactive to aid exploration and interpretation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inclusion and exclusion of funding types
rubrics_metrics.description: Includes grants and other transactions, while excluding Research and Development contracts and intramural funding.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Users should note these boundaries when interpreting totals and trends because excluded funding types can affect overall funding patterns.

rubrics_metrics.name: Current fiscal year estimates are provisional
rubrics_metrics.description: Includes estimates for the current fiscal year, which are subject to change.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Data for the ongoing fiscal year may be updated; users should treat current-year values as provisional and check back for revisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Track funding patterns across fiscal years
rubrics_metrics.description: Enables users to track funding patterns across fiscal years, including when awards are most frequently issued.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the resource to identify seasonal patterns (e.g., months with more awards) and compare issuance timing across different fiscal years.

rubrics_metrics.name: Compare award counts versus total funding
rubrics_metrics.description: Allows comparison between award counts and total funding.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Viewing both metrics helps distinguish whether changes in funding reflect more awards, larger awards, or both; the resource provides separate charts for count and funding amount.

rubrics_metrics.name: Access via NIH RePORTER and NIH Data Book
rubrics_metrics.description: Users can access these charts through NIH RePORTER or the 'Monthly NIH Awards Overview' in the NIH Data Book.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Multiple access points are provided depending on user preference or workflow; RePORTER may link into other project-level details while the Data Book provides overview context.

rubrics_metrics.name: Filter by fiscal year(s)
rubrics_metrics.description: Select one or more fiscal years to display.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Filtering enables focused comparisons (e.g., recent years vs. historical baseline) and helps isolate effects of specific funding environments or events.

rubrics_metrics.name: View exact monthly values via hover
rubrics_metrics.description: Hover over data points to view exact monthly values.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Interactive tooltips provide precise numbers without exporting data; useful for quick checks of individual months.

rubrics_metrics.name: Toggle visibility of years using legend
rubrics_metrics.description: Use the legend to show or hide specific years.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Legend controls let users simplify the chart to focus on particular fiscal years or compare a subset of years more clearly.

rubrics_metrics.name: Export data and chart images
rubrics_metrics.description: View and export data in a table format for detailed analysis or the charts as images for presentations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Exporting supports downstream analysis (e.g., in spreadsheets) and incorporation of visuals into reports or presentations; use table export for numeric work and image export for slides.

rubrics_metrics.name: Regular monthly data updates
rubrics_metrics.description: Please check back monthly as the data are updated.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The resource is refreshed on a monthly cadence; analysts should re-check for updated estimates and newly posted months to ensure analyses use the latest data.

rubrics_metrics.name: Contextual interpretation of anomalies
rubrics_metrics.description: Charts and narrative note notable events (e.g., a dip in October–November 2025) and explain causes such as delays in award issuance due to a lapse in appropriations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Users should consider external events (appropriations delays, policy changes) when interpreting dips or spikes rather than assuming underlying research activity changed proportionally.

rubrics_metrics.name: Purpose: transparency and understanding of NIH investments
rubrics_metrics.description: The resource helps the research community and public better understand NIH investments in biomedical research and supports NIH's commitment to transparency (NIH Gold Standard Science plan).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the resource as part of broader analyses and reporting to communicate NIH funding patterns and to inform planning by institutions and investigators.
